expenses.basis: Actual = expenses approved or paid, dated within the academic year, in reporting currency at each expense's recorded rate.

definitionText.billed: Charges minus discounts of invoices issued in the range (cancelled invoices excluded), at each invoice's rate.
definitionText.collected: Payments received in the range (confirmed, or reversed later) minus reversals dated in the range. Pending and failed payments are excluded.
definitionText.outstanding: Balance at the end date of invoices issued by then, counting only payments received and not reversed by then.
definitionText.collectionRate: Eligible collections ÷ amounts due × 100. Due = installments due by the end date, less discounts. Collections are capped at the amount due per invoice, so prepayments and credit do not inflate the rate; amounts not yet due are excluded.
definitionText.expenses: Expenses approved or paid, dated in the range.
definitionText.netCashResult: Collected − refunds − expenses paid in the range. A cash view, not profitability.
definitionText.operatingResult: Billed − expenses (approved or paid) in the range. Validate against the school's accounting policy.
definitionText.exchangeDifferences: Realized gains (+) or losses (−) on payments in the range, between the invoice's rate and the payment's rate.
